name: Monmusu ni Seifuku Sareta Sekai
original_name: もんむすに征服された世界
source:
This is a novel RPG, you'll not be acting as a invincible worrior like others, you'll be mortal. Hell, you are less than mortal. Hoping to end in happiness and be legendary, the MC is at the same time, weak and spineless. 

But one day, a portal opened for appearantly no reason, evils poured in - the devil who wants to rule the world, slime princess that's acutally kinda cute, blood-thirsting succubus, fox of mystery and sexy mermaids. Humans were in shock and had no clue how to get rid of them, the whole world is in chaos.

There's your chance! Go for it! You went into the mountains but recklessly slipped and fell to the bottom of a pit. When you woke up, a sword appeared from nowhere and tell you 'You are the one who's gonna save the world!' 

"But can I?" You wondered. You eagarly turn your sword to the pretty monstress and it turned out nothing's changed. The monstresses were still deadly and killed you instantly.

BUT!
Huh? I thought I died!
What's this place? Why am I still alive?
After died a couple of times, you realized that you cannot die. 

The monstresses had killed you over and over again, but you got stronger in the process. The mankind is for me to save! Charge! 
No! Upon awakening, he finds an unfamiliar sword in his hand.
“Use the LifeSword, and save your world from devastation.”
He hears a voice resonate from somewhere…
Can such a weak young man like himself really save the world…?
Half in doubt, the protagonist takes the LifeSword and challenges
a monster in battle but… his expectations are totally betrayed.

For he is almost instantly defeated, consecutively
reverse r*ped and upon being sucked dry… dies…

All hope is……….. NOT LOST!

Huh? I thought I died? What’s going on…?
That’s right, he revives from the dead!
Even more powerful than before!?

As the prophecy tells, can this young hero (YOU) really fight
against the evil monster girls and reclaim the world for humanity?
translation:
這是一款小說式RPG。你不會像其他作品的主角那樣成為無敵戰士，而是一個凡人。不，你甚至比凡人還弱。主角渴望以幸福結局和傳奇人生收場，卻同時軟弱又沒骨氣。

然而某天，一扇不知為何開啟的傳送門出現，邪惡勢力從中湧出：企圖統治世界的惡魔、其實有點可愛的史萊姆公主、嗜血的魅魔、神秘的狐狸，以及性感的人魚。人類震驚不已，完全不知道該如何消滅這些敵人，整個世界陷入混亂。

機會來了！衝上去吧！你進入山中，卻魯莽地滑倒，掉進深坑底部。醒來時，一把憑空出現的劍對你說：「你就是拯救世界的人！」

「可我真的能做到嗎？」你心想。你興奮地把劍指向漂亮的怪物娘，卻發現什麼都沒改變。怪物娘依舊致命，瞬間就殺死了你。

但是！

等等？我不是死了嗎？
這裡是什麼地方？我為什麼還活著？

死過幾次後，你意識到自己無法真正死去。

怪物娘一遍又一遍殺死你，可你也在過程中變得更強。人類由我來拯救！衝啊！

不！醒來後，他發現手中握著一把陌生的劍。

「使用生命之劍，從毀滅中拯救你的世界。」

一個聲音從某處傳來，在他耳邊迴響……

像他這樣軟弱的年輕人，真的能拯救世界嗎……？

主角半信半疑地拿起生命之劍，向怪物發起挑戰，可……結果完全出乎他的預料。

因為他幾乎瞬間就被擊敗，接連遭到反向強姦，被吸得一乾二淨……最終死去……

一切希望都……並沒有消失！

等等？我不是死了嗎？怎麼回事……？

沒錯，他從死亡中復活了！
而且比之前更加強大！？

正如預言所說，這位年輕英雄（也就是你）真的能與邪惡的怪物娘戰鬥，為人類奪回世界嗎？
